svg.title: One possible evolving course: rising baseline, recurrent lates, falling variability
svg.desc: Three 3-minute synthetic excerpts from one labor, at 0, 25 and 55 minutes, at US paper scale. Baseline rises from 135 to 150 to 165 bpm (new tachycardia); the first window has moderate variability and an acceleration, the second recurrent late decelerations, the third minimal variability and longer late decelerations with less recovery. A dashed line marks the first baseline in later windows. Contractions about every 2 minutes. One possible course; sequence and timing vary.
